summary: 1.19.0 The discussion centers on how Parquet readers should resolve a FILE logical type value when both inline data and a URI locator are present, as different engines currently return different bytes. The authors recommend including Delta mode in the initial PFOR specification to improve compression for sorted data, while deferring interleaving and Unified Transposed Layout (UTL) to a later phase. ## What's Changed * MINOR: [1.18.x] Revert "Set version to 1.18.2 for release" by @manuzhang in https://github.com/apache/parquet-java/pull/3931 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/apache/parquet-java/compare/apache-parquet-1.18.2-rc0...apache-parquet-1.18.2-rc1 The discussion centers on adding a new FINITE_VECTOR type to Parquet and how Iceberg should handle unannotated list data. Participants raise backward‑compatibility concerns, arguing that Iceberg should accept existing LIST<FLOAT>/LI
